world3_standard.label: Legacy/reference Pyworld3 standard run (1974 implementation)
world3_standard.description: Default constants in the legacy/reference Pyworld3 1.1 implementation; not the retained official World3-03 EWD structural baseline.

bau2_structural_proxy.label: Legacy Pyworld3 BAU2 structural proxy: doubled nonrenewable resources
bau2_structural_proxy.description: Legacy/reference sensitivity proxy in which a larger resource stock delays the resource constraint and permits greater industrial and pollution pressure. It is not the official World3-03 BAU2 parameterization and is not the retained EWD structural baseline.
